scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --config ../firebase.json --project opocompit-dev --only auth,firestore,functions
scripts.verify:emulator: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --config ../firebase.json --project opocompit-dev --only auth,firestore,functions "npm run seed:emulator && npm run smoke:emulator"
scripts.deploy: npm run build && firebase deploy --only functions
